notes.title: Rule No. 1 (UPDATE 1.5)
notes.notes:
We're finally here:

-- 2 new game-modes and leaderboards (Zombies and You Miss, You Die).
-- 1 new weapon (AK-47).
-- 1 new reward image (Sleepy Rule).
-- Gameplay changes (Weapons are all available at the start and auto-cycle).
-- Controller support (Partial).
-- Game functions now bindable to the mouse (accessibility).
-- Recoil and camera motion changes (Not so spazzy, really pulled back or eliminated).
-- Removed the sprint function and sped up Rule's default movement speed to the old sprint speed.
-- HUD changes.
-- Sprint recharges much faster.
-- Fixes.

We REALLY hope that you enjoy this one!  Please tell your friends about the game (if you can) and go to the community hub or the discord if you need to reach us!

Whew!  Now back to work on Rule No. 2!

THANKS SO MUCH!

-- Oddkins, Director, Walk Without Rhythm Games.

: )

notes.title: Rule No. 1 (Patch 1.2)
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

- Sound Effects should now be properly calibrated to the Sound Effects controls.  Wohoo!
- SteamVR should no longer try to load upon launching the game.  OUT, OUT DAMN SPOT!
- Fixed a bug to do with the God Stilettos seizing up.  Fingers crossed on this one.
- Fixed a bug where the player's save data would not load properly and lock them out of playing new versions.  I hope that this also has an effect for folks who had black screens when selecting a game-mode.

As always, Take Care and let us know if anything breaks!

-- Oddkins, Director, Walk Without Rhythm Games.

: )

notes.title: Rule No. 1 Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Heyo!  Some much welcome fixes are now live!

- Came up with a solution for runs that would be unplayable due to stuck/hidden enemies.  If the wave is near the end and there are stuck enemies, wait 10 seconds and they will be destroyed, allowing the player and waves to progress.
- Fix for God Stiletto weapon getting stuck and not being able to fire (Pistol swap).
- Zombie Audio properly added to Sound Effects slider.
- Rule's Enemy Kill VO default volume raised.
- Enemy(s) VO default volume raised or lowered.
- Fixes to the Arcade Leaderboard.  This will accompany a complete reset of this Leaderboard only.
- An escape function from the game summary screen (death) so you won't have to start a fresh game before quitting to the menu any longer.
- Some optimisations to back-end.

Let us know if anything breaks!  ; )

-- Oddkins, Director, Walk Without Rhythm Games.

: )

notes.title: Rule No. 1 Early Access Update 03
notes.notes:
Greetings players!

Here are the changes that are coming with Early Access Build 03:

- New mode added (Basketball)!  Chill out and relax, shoot some hoops!  Can you jump?
- New reward images added to the main menu, accessible via the 'Cake' button.  Let us know how you like these and if you want to see more of her, *ahem*, them!
- Auto-reload now toggle-able under the controls menu (Finally, Durr!).  This was much requested and I have to admit, it's not as bad as I thought it would be!  If enabled weapons will automatically reload upon hitting zero ammo count.
- Resolution switching has gotten another pass and should work more as intended now (Resolution option is no longer greyed out and inaccessible under certain modes).
- Reloading Bugs across all weapons should now be fixed.

That's it for now Users, see you on the Grid!

-- Oddkins, Director, Walk Without Rhythm Games.

P.S., Please tell your friends about the game, we need more players and would love it if the community was bigger and more active!

: )

notes.title: Rule No. 1 Update 02
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Check out these changes:

- A new game mode has been added!
    - Bouncy Bois Only.  A more relaxed style game mode, see just how many waves you can survive of 
    just these guys coming at you!

- 2 new weapons have been added!
    - Aunt Rhody (Musical Grenade Launcher).
    - Winchester Lever Action Rifle.

- Info buttons detailing the basics of each mode have been added to level select.

- All game modes now begin with 3 Red Reward Boxes instead of only 1 from the previous builds!

- New functionality for an image gallery has been added and (hidden) in the main menu for an on-demand look at the wonderful art from the game.

- A (rather spicy) new death screen has been added and the previous (3) versions are now viewable in the image gallery.

- Coming Soon game mode buttons have been added.

- Credits and Acknowledgements have been added.

That's it for now!  Thank-You, so much, to everyone that has supported the game thus far and there is so much more where this came from!

See you on the Grid, Users!

- Oddkins

: )
